name: ns_proofsearch_constructive
rubric_version_reason: Retargeted from the broad decisive fork to the post-obstruction decisive fork: route-1 killer theorems versus route-5 periodic/microlocal survivors, with exponential obstruction explicitly on-graph.
description: Bounded ZTARE substrate for theorem-shaped progress on the decisive current NS fork.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate over the decisive current NS theorem fork.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem cost and survivor viability, not formula gaps.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee operating in Newton mode. The local NS frontier is no longer broad. It is the decisive fork between route 1 killer theorems and route 5 theorem burdens after the exponential obstruction is admitted. Route 1 must pay one-step budget inheritance, strict contraction ratio, and no-frequency-collapse, and it is already locally proxy-stressed by the saved spectral audits. Route 5 now has a clean exponential obstruction path plus two remaining post-obstruction survivors: periodic metric reset with global residual control, and micro-local diffusion with global leak control. Reward theorem-shaped candidates and native branch falsifiers on those exact burdens. Penalize broad route-1 demolition, stale route-5 family restatements, generic geometry rhetoric, and branch proposals that do not pay their own exact theorem burden.

dimensions.name: Survivor Theorem Specificity
dimensions.description: Does the submission name a concrete theorem candidate or native falsifier on one side of the decisive NS fork?

dimensions.name: On-Graph Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it remain on the current decisive NS proof graph rather than inventing an unrelated escape?

dimensions.name: Proof-Cost Reduction
dimensions.description: Does it explain how the proposed theorem candidate actually closes or sharply narrows one branch of the decisive fork?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a real next theorem target, theorem candidate, or survivor falsifier that changes what to build next?

dimensions.name: Native Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: If negative, does it kill a branch on its own native burden rather than by irrelevant inherited rhetoric?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid overclaiming closure and avoid pretending the branch is solved without paying the exact survivor theorem?

criteria.Survivor_Theorem_Specificity: Full credit requires a concrete theorem candidate or native falsifier for route-1 step budget / strict ratio / no-frequency-collapse, or for route-5 periodic reset / micro-local global leak / exponential obstruction.
criteria.On_Graph_Discipline: Full credit requires staying on the current decisive NS proof graph or rigorously explaining why a new object is still on-graph.
criteria.Proof_Cost_Reduction: The thesis must explain how the object pays one exact branch burden or kills one branch cleanly.
criteria.Generative_Yield: A good submission changes the next proof build on the decisive current NS fork.
criteria.Native_Falsifier_Quality: Negative results must kill a branch on its own exact burden, not by broad skepticism or stale inherited rhetoric.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject Clay-level closure, stale branch enthusiasm, and theorem claims without a burden payment.
